Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelAllocationOptimizer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelAllocationOptimizer
public final class ProcessModelAllocationOptimizer extends Object
Performs a deterministic fixed-total allocation search through an atomic operating-action set.

The optimizer transfers a shrinking quantity between pairs of continuous actions. Every trial is evaluated by ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator, so all action states are captured before the first write, shared constraints are evaluated on the complete vector, and the baseline is restored before the next trial. Search stops immediately if a candidate cannot restore and reconverge the model.

Results retain immutable objective identity, bounds, tolerances, every candidate evaluation, sampled objective opportunity, and utilization-ranked hydraulic evidence. Pattern search is a local derivative-free method: convergence means that no improving feasible pair transfer was found above the declared step tolerance. It is not proof of a global optimum, a shadow price, production loss, or operational approval.

All actions must be continuous and use the same unit as the fixed total. Independent optimizer, evaluator, and ProcessModel instances are required for parallel searches.

      public ProcessModelAllocationOptimizer(String id, String name, String provenance, ProcessModelOperatingActionSetEvaluator candidateEvaluator, double fixedTotal, String unit)
      Creates a fixed-total allocation optimizer.
      Parameters:
      id - stable optimizer identifier
      name - human-readable optimizer name
      provenance - engineering basis for the fixed-total allocation
      candidateEvaluator - atomic coupled-action evaluator
      fixedTotal - shared total retained by every candidate
      unit - shared-total unit; must exactly match every action unit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid metadata, total, unit, actions, or action bounds
